script.es: Madera con diseño, hecha para tu espacio.
script.en: Designed woodwork, built for your space.

parrafo.es: R&R Woodwork diseña y construye muebles empotrados, mesas de madera viva y closets a medida en West Palm Beach. Renee y su equipo trabajan de la mano con el diseñador o el cliente hasta el último detalle.
parrafo.en: R&R Woodwork designs and builds built-in furniture, live edge tables and custom closets in West Palm Beach. Renee and his team work closely with the designer or client through every detail.

hero.imagen_alt: Mesa y banca de madera viva construidas por R&R Woodwork

parrafo_1.es: R&R Woodwork es un taller de carpintería en West Palm Beach dirigido por Renee, dedicado a muebles empotrados, mesas de madera viva y closets a medida. Cada proyecto se diseña para el espacio real del cliente.
parrafo_1.en: R&R Woodwork is a West Palm Beach shop run by Renee, dedicated to built-in furniture, live edge tables and custom closets. Every project is designed for the client's actual space.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes destacan lo atento y detallista que es Renee durante todo el proceso, desde el diseño hasta la instalación final, siempre coordinando de cerca con los plazos del proyecto.
parrafo_2.en: Clients point to how attentive and detailed Renee is through the whole process, from design to final installation, always coordinating closely with the project timeline.

texto.es: Nos cuentas tu idea y la trabajamos contigo o con tu diseñador.
texto.en: Tell us your idea and we work through it with you or your designer.

texto.es: Medimos el espacio real y te damos el precio antes de empezar.
texto.en: We measure your actual space and give you the price before we start.

texto.es: Cada pieza se fabrica en el taller con la madera y el acabado elegidos.
texto.en: Every piece is built in the shop with the chosen wood and finish.

texto.es: Instalamos con cuidado y dejamos el espacio listo para disfrutarse.
texto.en: We install with care and leave the space ready to enjoy.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza según el diseño, la madera y el tamaño. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on design, wood and size. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Centros de entretenimiento y libreros de piso a techo diseñados para tu pared.
texto.en: Floor-to-ceiling entertainment centers and bookshelves designed for your wall.

texto.es: Mesas y bancas de una sola pieza de madera, con el borde natural a la vista.
texto.en: Single-slab tables and benches with the natural edge left on display.

texto.es: Closets e islas diseñadas para aprovechar cada centímetro del espacio.
texto.en: Closets and islands designed to make use of every inch of the space.

texto.es: Repisas de madera maciza instaladas sin soportes visibles.
texto.en: Solid wood shelves installed with no visible supports.

pie.es: ¿Tienes un proyecto fuera de catálogo? Llámanos, también construimos gallineros a medida.
pie.en: Have a project outside the usual list? Call us, we even build custom chicken coops.

items.quote: R&R Woodwork did absolutely beautiful work. The built-ins turned out gorgeous and completely elevated my living room, taking them all the way to the ceiling made such a difference.

R&R Woodwork implemented a built in unit for my Kids Den. From start to finish the process and communication was very professional and timely. Renee had many thoughtful details and additions to our initial design.

We are thrilled with our new home office space. Renee and his team did a phenomenal job and worked with our designer to achieve the exact look we were hoping for. We were out of town while the job was completed and he handled every aspect.

texto.en: The fastest way to tell us about your project.
